key.name: icon-size
key.description: Largest size of dock icons, in logical pixels. Icons shrink further when there are too many to fit.

key.name: custom-launcher-icon
key.description: Show the raccoon instead of the grid on the app grid button.

key.name: glass
key.description: Show the dock background as translucent frosted glass over a blurred wallpaper.

key.name: autohide
key.description: Hide the dock when a window overlaps it. Push the pointer against the bottom edge of the screen to reveal it.

key.name: reveal-pressure
key.description: How far the pointer has to push past the bottom edge, in pixels within one second, to reveal a hidden dock.

key.name: magnification-size
key.description: Size of the icon directly under the pointer, in logical pixels.
